## Definition of Done

- [ ] The task links to a spec, and the spec's acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] Tests were written first and they fail without this change
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Type hints everywhere; no `Any` that is not justified in a comment
- [ ] No new dependency, or the PR says why the new one is needed
- [ ] No secrets, video, datasets or model weights in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or setup changed
- [ ] The tasks.md checkbox is ticked
